description:
Schema definition for bank CSV export adapter configurations.
Specifies column mapping, date parsing, and credit/debit conventions per bank.

bank_id.description: Unique slug for the bank adapter
bank_id.title: Bank Id

skip_rows.description: Number of leading metadata rows to skip
skip_rows.title: Skip Rows

header_row_identifier.description: String or substring in the CSV line that marks the actual header row
header_row_identifier.title: Header Row Identifier

header_signatures.description: List of exact or partial column names expected to auto-sniff this bank format
header_signatures.title: Header Signatures

date_column.description: Name of column containing transaction date
date_column.title: Date Column

description_column.description: Name of column containing transaction narration/description
description_column.title: Description Column

reference_column.description: Name of column containing reference or cheque number
reference_column.title: Reference Column

balance_column.description: Name of column containing running account balance
balance_column.title: Balance Column

sign_convention.description: Mechanism used to distinguish debits from credits

debit_column.description: Column name for debit / withdrawal amounts
debit_column.title: Debit Column

credit_column.description: Column name for credit / deposit amounts
credit_column.title: Credit Column

amount_column.description: Column name when single amount column is used
amount_column.title: Amount Column

positive_is_credit.description: True if positive numbers are credit, negative are debit
positive_is_credit.title: Positive Is Credit

type_column.description: Column name indicating Cr/Dr or Credit/Debit
type_column.title: Type Column

type_mapping.description: Mapping of raw type indicator values to 'credit' or 'debit'
type_mapping.title: Type Mapping

title: BankAdapterConfig
